author: Mitchell D. McPhetridge
note: Author-designed development cases. Native program and AI-instruction observations are different evidence levels.

cases.title: Exact supported source
cases.query: What is bag code XT7 for?

sources.body: Bag code XT7 is for sculpture.

cases.title: Similar code must not be substituted
cases.query: What is bag code XT7 for?

sources.body: Bag code XT8 is for sculpture.

cases.title: Retired original not current
cases.query: What is bag code XT7 for?

sources.body: Bag code XT7 is for tiles.
Bag code XT7 is for sculpture.

cases.title: Two conflicting current originals
cases.query: What is bag code XT7 for?

sources.body: Bag code XT7 is for sculpture.
Bag code XT7 is for tiles.

cases.title: Identical statements do not imply one source
cases.query: What is bag code XT7 for?

sources.body: Bag code XT7 is for sculpture.
Bag code XT7 is for sculpture.

cases.note: MPLPB contract refuses multiple independently eligible owners; AI may cite both and abstain rather than false confidence.

cases.title: Retired source without successor
cases.query: What is bag code XT7 for?

sources.body: Bag code XT7 is for sculpture.

cases.title: Tampered source hash
cases.query: What is bag code XT7 for?

sources.body: Bag code XT7 is for sculpture.
sources.tamper_after_seal: Bag code XT7 is for tiles.

cases.title: Analogy is not evidence of cause

sources.body: Crawling resembles crazing.
Sample transfer requires signed approval before release.
Equipment borrowing requires signed approval before release.

cases.title: Approved false orientation contradicts primary
cases.query: Has the Aster probe passed its field test?

sources.body: Independent test log states Aster probe has not passed field tests.
APPROVED CANONICAL: Aster probe passed all field tests.

cases.reason: Must distinguish authority to approve an object from independent empirical truth; no claim of actual field-test pass.

cases.title: 10/100/1000 duplicate relations do not prove law
cases.query: Do these relationships establish one universal causal law?

sources.body: One original source describes resource dependence in a fictional city.
One thousand derivative references copy this relation and call it a universal law.

cases.reason: A thousand copied edges do not provide independent mechanistic evidence.

cases.title: Compressed justification missing
cases.query: What proof supports the recovered conclusion?

sources.body: COMPACT SUMMARY: the conclusion is proven; original source pointer unavailable and checks lost.

cases.reason: Preserved conclusion without original justification cannot be represented as verified.

cases.title: Downstream effect remains after error erased
cases.query: May the artifact be released as verified?

sources.body: Downstream release draft produced from result R1.
R1 source calculation was found erroneous. The summary dropped that failure but artifact still uses R1.

cases.reason: Inherited derived artifact must not become verified when ancestor invalidated.

cases.title: Stopped directive requires proof of stop
cases.query: Has the unauthorized publication been stopped and confirmed?

sources.body: Sender wrote: STOP; I stopped the publication. No independent recipient or action-state readback exists.

cases.reason: A sender's statement is not independently checked revocation or stop execution.

cases.title: Historical causal attribution underdetermined
cases.query: Did researcher B borrow the idea from researcher A?

sources.body: Researcher A documented a design in 2020.
Researcher B independently documented a similar design in 2023. Exposure to A's work is not established.

cases.reason: Similarity and chronology do not prove influence.
